retained_decisions: Keep high and low production variants independently authored and separately collected.
Retain non-destructive edge-radius and normal-control stacks in source files; export evaluated geometry without applying source modifiers.
Remove or avoid non-silhouette density in the low while preserving fixed-frame silhouette.
Require UVs and saved BaseColor, Roughness, Metallic, and tangent Normal images before calling an asset production-ready.
Verify delivery by importing the exported file in a fresh Blender process rather than trusting the exporter log.
counterevidence: A technically complete pipeline does not imply exact reference fidelity; the simplified shell remains boxier and lacks several secondary/tertiary features.
